system.description: You can use your ability to circumvent Behavioral Inhibitors to temporarily break the programming of a Droid that you have a data link with. Make a Use Computer check opposed by the Droid's Will Defense. Breaking the Droid's programming overrides its Behavioral Inhibitors for a number of rounds equal to your Intelligence bonus.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
